meta.description: Maksymilian Ziembicki – Full-Stack Developer based in Warsaw. I design and build web applications with TypeScript, NestJS and Next.js: from backend architecture and the database to a polished interface, with AI built in predictably and safely.

hero.intro: I design and build complete web applications – from backend architecture and the database to a polished interface. I work with TypeScript, NestJS and Next.js, and bring AI into products in a way that is predictable and safe.

paragraphs.p1: My journey into tech started with games on the PSP. Over time I became more and more fascinated by how they are made, what makes them work, and how the world on the screen can react to what we do.
paragraphs.p2: That curiosity turned into a desire to build things of my own. When I discovered programming, I wanted to try it straight away. I started with websites and simple browser games, looking for a way to turn my own ideas into something tangible. Being able to create things and see the results of my work still fascinates me today.
paragraphs.p3: Each stage of my IT education let me develop this passion and understand the world of software better. Over time I found myself most at home in backend development, and today I feel most confident in NestJS. My first professional experience, mostly on the frontend, gave me a broader view of applications, from both the interface and the server side. I enjoy challenges and believe that most problems can be solved if you give them enough time and commitment.
paragraphs.p4: Outside of programming, I am passionate about sport, above all football. I have supported Chelsea FC since I was a kid, and as soon as I had the chance, I started travelling to London for matches. I am also fascinated by Great Britain: its architecture, culture, film, music and food. I follow Formula 1, supporting the Mercedes-AMG Petronas team, and lately I have been developing an interest in 3D graphics.
